key_points: Chipotle pilots Palantir data platform after recent salmonella recall, indicating operational risk mitigation but also signaling recent food‑safety issues
Recent 1–1.4% price decline reflects valuation pressure and market nervousness rather than fundamental change
No earnings or guidance updates; news is largely short‑term operational and valuation focus
Potential upside limited until clear impact of Palantir partnership on safety and cost efficiency is demonstrated
Overall sentiment modestly negative with limited lasting impact unless further safety incidents emerge
